title: observability-pipeline-debug-notes-samira-wip
body:
Purpose: scratchpad for recent regression where spans and metrics dropped intermittently between 02/17-02/19. Collecting commands run, outputs, quick hypotheses and next steps.

Symptoms observed:
- Traces: ~40% of traces (sampled) missing downstream in zipkin/jaeger after otel-collector. Spans appear to be received by upstream services (local SDK logs) but are not visible in the trace UI.
- Metrics: a sharp drop in request_count and latency_histogram ingestion for api-gateway between 2026-02-17 03:10 UTC and 2026-02-17 04:05 UTC; partial recovery after restart of metrics-processor.
- Logs: recent log lines from some services not indexed in ES for ~55 minutes. Ingest pipeline shows consumer lag spikes.

Timeline (quick):
- 2026-02-17 02:58 UTC: deployment of otel-collector v0.12.3 (helm rollout) - config change: sampling tail-based enabled + new kafka exporter settings (acks=1).
- 2026-02-17 03:07 UTC: alerts fired for trace missing rate and metrics drop (pager).
- 2026-02-17 03:12 UTC: infra attempted soft restart of otel-collector pod (rotation to previous replica) - partial recovery in metrics by 03:40 UTC.
- 2026-02-17 03:50 UTC: manual restart of metrics-processor (k8s) - metrics largely recovered by 04:00 UTC. Traces still missing until 04:15 UTC after scaling otel-collector to 3 replicas.

Commands tried (and outputs):
1) Check pods and restarts
$ kubectl -n observability get pods -o wide
NAME                                    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
otel-collector-5c8b9f7b7d-9xjpl    1/1     Running   2          7d
otel-collector-5c8b9f7b7d-bm2cz    1/1     Running   0          3h
metrics-processor-0                     2/2     Running   1          9d

Observation: one otel replica had 2 restarts (evicted earlier). New replica created during rollout.

2) Tail otel logs around incident
$ kubectl -n observability logs otel-collector-5c8b9f7b7d-9xjpl --since=2h
2026-02-17T03:05:12.345Z WARN exporter/kafka/kafka.go:101 failed to send batch: write tcp 10.2.5.8:51344->10.3.1.12:9092: write: connection reset by peer
2026-02-17T03:05:12.347Z ERROR service/service.go:215 Could not export traces: kafka exporter failed for 152 spans
2026-02-17T03:06:02.102Z WARN exporter/kafka/kafka.go:256 producer error: broker not available

3) Check kafka broker connectivity and consumer groups
$ kubectl -n infra exec -it kafka-broker-0 -- kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --describe --group observability-processor
GROUP           TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG     CONSUMER-ID         HOST           CLIENT-ID
observability-processor  logs-raw        0          124231          124231          0       consumer-1          /10.3.1.20     consumer-1
observability-processor  traces          0          98012           110213          12201  consumer-2          /10.3.1.22     consumer-2
Observation: big consumer lag for traces topic during window.

4) Curl internal write endpoint (metrics) to validate auth/certs
$ curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ${OTEL_TOKEN}" https://otel-ingest.internal.redwood/api/v1/metrics/write -d '{}'
* Connected to otel-ingest.internal.redwood (10.3.1.18) port 443 (#0)
* ALPN, offering http/1.1
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (1)
* SSL certificate verify ok
> POST /api/v1/metrics/write HTTP/1.1
> Host: otel-ingest.internal.redwood
> Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
> Content-Type: application/json
> Content-Length: 2
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 03:13:11 GMT
< content-type: application/json
< content-length: 91
< {"error":"forbidden","message":"token missing required scope: metrics:write"}
Observation: some otel-collector instances were sending requests that failed auth (403 scopes). This lines up with version change which might have changed token scoping or exporter credentials.

5) Check otel-collector config map used in helm chart
$ kubectl -n observability get configmap otel-collector-config -o yaml
# (snip)
exporters:
  kafka/traces:
    brokers: ["kafka:9092"]
    topic: traces
    acks: 1
  http/metrics:
    endpoint: https://otel-ingest.internal.redwood/api/v1/metrics/write
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer {{ OTEL_TOKEN }}"

Note: acks:1 was explicitly set in rollout. Previously it was -1 (all).

Partial logs (span drop) from app side (service-a):
2026-02-17T03:04:59Z INFO span_end id=8a3f... status=OK duration_ms=12 export=queued
2026-02-17T03:05:12Z ERROR exporter client error: failed to send spans: kafka: write tcp: connection reset
2026-02-17T03:05:13Z INFO span_retry queued for export attempt=1
2026-02-17T03:07:01Z INFO span_dropped id=8a3f... reason=max_retries_exceeded

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Kafka broker instability during rollout (broker disconnects) caused backpressure; kafka exporter configured with acks=1 led to lost writes when brokers flapped. This explains missing spans and consumer lag.
2) New otel-collector image introduced an exporter bug (edge-case NPE) causing partial export failures. Investigate release notes between v0.12.2 -> v0.12.3.
3) Auth token rotation/templating bug in helm chart caused some replicas to render wrong OTEL_TOKEN (missing scopes). Explains 403 on metrics endpoint.
4) Resource pressure (file descriptors) on otel-collector pod causing intermittent connection resets - less likely given pod CPU/mem stable.

Quick checks to validate hypotheses:
- Reproduce auth 403: check the rendered secret in each replica pod:
$ kubectl -n observability exec otel-collector-5c8b9f7b7d-9xjpl -- printenv | grep OTEL
OTEL_TOKEN=REDACTED
- Confirm token scopes by decoding token (internal tool)
$ /workspace/tools/token-inspector decode $OTEL_TOKEN
{"scopes": ["traces:write"], "exp": 170XXX}
Observation: example token lacks metrics:write. Need to trace helm template that provides token.

- Check kafka health and broker restarts in infra logs between 03:00-03:20
$ kubectl -n infra get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=kafka-broker-0 --since=30m
(some events showing network blips, but need to pull broker logs)

Immediate mitigations performed so far:
- rolled back otel-collector to v0.12.2 on 03:20 UTC (helm rollback) - metrics recovered faster; traces partially recovered after scaling collectors to 3 replicas.
- temporarily increased kafka replica.min.insync.replicas back to previous value and reverted acks to -1 in configmap.

Open action items / next steps:
- [ ] Verify helm chart templating for OTEL_TOKEN: ensure secret ref picks token with metrics:write + traces:write scopes. (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Run canary rollout with v0.12.3 in staging cluster with kafka broker flaps simulated (chaos) to reproduce lost spans (owner: Eli)
- [ ] Attach broker logs for 2026-02-17 02:55-03:20 UTC and correlate with otel errors (owner: infra oncall)
- [ ] Create alert for kafka exporter error rate in otel-collector (already added to alerting rules)
- [ ] Add retries/backoff config to kafka exporter in otel config if not present (short-term fix)

Notes to self / reminders:
- we need a postmortem draft once triage done; include timeline, root cause, and followups about templating + helm chart unit tests for token scopes.
- check if any downstream APM hooks drop spans on missing parent_id (recent change in instrumentation?).
- don't forget to update runbooks: how to rollback otel collector and how to validate token scopes.

Questions for the team:
- Did anyone update the token provisioning service last week? (Priya?)
- Is there a reason otel Helm chart changed default acks? Who approved that change?

Raw errors collected (copy):
ERROR exporter/kafka/kafka.go:101 failed to send batch: write tcp 10.2.5.8:51344->10.3.1.12:9092: write: connection reset by peer
ERROR service/service.go:215 Could not export traces: kafka exporter failed for 152 spans
{"error":"forbidden","message":"token missing required scope: metrics:write"}
span_dropped id=8a3f... reason=max_retries_exceeded

If I don't update this doc in the next 24h, assume I'm in oncall rotation and will handover to Eli.

-- Samira
